snippet.title: Nitro Turtles Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NITRO TURTLES ON STEAM! LET'S MAKE THIS THE ULTIMATE TURTLE RACING GAME!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3952070/Nitro_Turtles/

Join the Nitro Turtles Discord!
https://discord.gg/tGyspuvBnP

Nitro Turtles is a racing game about super fast turtles! Reach insane speeds with awesome shell-attached gadgets, compete in crazy races with friends, and sprint across the finish line to claim ultimate turtle victory!
